question: Where and when was Meridian 2026 held, given that older announcements named Abu Dhabi?

golden.answer: Meridian 2026 was held October 28–29, 2026 at Convento do Beato in Lisbon, Portugal. Earlier announcements of Abu Dhabi (Yas Marina, October 21–22) were superseded when SDF announced the move to Lisbon on April 1, 2026.
keyFacts: Meridian 2026 was held October 28–29, 2026 at Convento do Beato, Lisbon.
Abu Dhabi, October 21–22 was superseded; SDF announced Lisbon on 2026-04-01.
avoid: Do NOT claim Meridian 2026 took place in Abu Dhabi/Yas Marina or on October 21–22.
golden.notes: Stale sponsored recaps and leftover listings show the superseded schedule; official SDF sources control.
